about.title: Brentwood Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a collision on Balfour Road, Brentwood Boulevard, Sand Creek Road, or SR-4 changes everything overnight, and the paperwork that follows can feel impossible to face while grieving. Contra Costa County recorded 3 traffic deaths in the most recent final crash year, alongside 165 injury collisions and 232 people injured, numbers that represent real families in and around Brentwood. California law gives surviving spouses, domestic partners, children, and in some cases other dependents the right to pursue a wrongful death claim, but that right comes with a strict two-year deadline from the date of death, sometimes shorter when a government entity is involved. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect grieving families with an independent attorney who can review what happened, explain your options, and help you understand what losses may be recoverable. There's no upfront cost, and the attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they're only paid if your family recovers compensation.

whyChoose.title: Why Brentwood Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to spouses, domestic partners, and children first, then other dependents or heirs. An attorney can help clarify where your family stands.

items.title: Watching the Clock
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of death to file, though claims against a government entity can require action much sooner. Missing that window can end a claim entirely.

items.title: Recovering What the Law Allows
items.desc: Beyond funeral costs, California law recognizes lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance as real, compensable losses for surviving family.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may be able to bring a claim. An attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm eligibility.

items.question: Is there a deadline for filing after a death on a Brentwood road?
items.answer: Yes, California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. That window can be much shorter if a government entity, such as a road authority responsible for a stretch of Sand Creek Road or SR-4, is involved. It's important to act promptly so evidence isn't lost.

items.question: Does LawProactive represent my family directly?
items.answer: No, LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent attorney in our network; we are not a law firm. The attorney you're matched with will handle your case directly, and their fee only applies if your family recovers compensation.
